formula_source: User-specified v2 bounded reciprocal-imbalance logit correction; independently implemented against this repository's native Attention.forward.
scope: Only backbone layer 10 C2PSA attention; native SPPF, CSP, QKV, PE(V), projection, FFN, residuals, neck and Detect retained.
inherited_reference_record: tools/experiments/rsc_sources.json; extracted files were reviewed during v1, requested ZIP identity was not established.
interpretation: Engineering hypothesis awaiting experiments; no guaranteed accuracy improvement or established academic novelty. Reciprocal attention has prior art. Dense N-squared attention and extra FP32 operations remain.
diagnostic_policy: Post-training bypass is inference diagnosis, not an independently trained ablation. Select structure using validation, not repeated test-set tuning.
